Name: 原生地毯轰炸默认携带 / Native CarpetBomb v0.5.3
Description: 地毯轰炸默认携带；菜单介绍始终中英双语，可配置次数、冷却、弹体和目标前移。数量固定每架20枚。需要Loader v18；菜单另需ModOptionsMenu v2。支持build 25480438。 / Automatically carries CarpetBomb. Bilingual descriptions in either language; configurable charges, cooldowns, bombs and forward offset. Fixed at 20 bombs per aircraft. Requires Loader v18; menu needs ModOptionsMenu v2. Build 25480438.

Options.Name: 核心 / Core
